new_findings.id: wrong primary locator for EC3 #218 in signatures_transforms scratch and errata index
new_findings.evidence: The primary PDF puts #218 Caret object 14145 on physical p.608 / printed p.593, targeting Table 263 /UR3 in the permissions dictionary. Table 264 is on physical p.609 / printed p.594. The caret says the /Reference entry is an array with at least one entry, exactly one of which is the UR signature reference. Both `doc/errata-read.md` and existing signatures_transforms text call this a Table 264 change; signatures_transforms therefore says it is unrelated to its consumer. In fact the signature permission parser selects the first matching UR transform, and viewer-core uses the rights in notes and revision comparison.
new_findings.disposition: Correct the locator/description. Do not promote a behavior failure from this producer-shape constraint. Cardinality is not tested, but reader consequences for malformed multi-UR input are not prescribed by this erratum.
